decisions.reason: Although more commercially and technologically adjacent than core machinery, this flagship binder still benefits from the firm's recycling know-how, in-house R&D and capacity to learn from early market feedback, so management would likely continue backing it while refining its application.

This decontamination plant is very close to the firm's established modular waste-treatment capabilities and partner-based engineering model, so absorptive capacity is high and continued commercialization is the likely choice.

A mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's core manufacturing, process and service knowledge especially well, making it the type of related product a growing German machinery firm would usually retain and improve rather than withdraw.
